_comment: Golden output for fixture.jpg produced by rfdetr-seg-preview (Roboflow project coco-dataset-vdnr1/26). The model output is the model's prediction, not human ground truth, so the bbox assertion uses a wide tolerance: it guards against pipeline/alias drift (e.g. the alias silently resolving to a different model), NOT model accuracy. Regenerate with ./regen-golden.sh after an intentional model/alias change.

dominant_person.comment: Highest-confidence person = the near on-court player. bbox center is Roboflow's center-x/center-y.
